title: 双亲委派与「打破委派」：两种 ClassLoader 的重写点
expected_output:
=== delegation chain (app -> ... -> bootstrap) ===
    level 0: jdk.internal.loader.ClassLoaders$AppClassLoader   parent=PlatformClassLoader
    level 1: jdk.internal.loader.ClassLoaders$PlatformClassLoader   parent=<bootstrap, native>
    PlatformClassLoader.getParent() == null (bootstrap) : true
=== delegating loader: java.lang.String resolved by bootstrap ===
    same Class object as String.class : true
=== breaking loader: tries itself first, then delegates ===
    Breaking tries first: java.lang.String
    got java.lang.String : true, same as bootstrap : true
=== class identity = loader + FQN ===
    B1 tries first: java.lang.String
    B2 tries first: java.lang.String
    two loaders, same FQN, same Class object : true
    reason: bootstrap already loaded it, both delegated up
